simple.prompt: In-text citation format (APA 7th): 'According to recent findings (___), carbon emissions have peaked.'
options: Smith, 2021
Smith (2021)
Smith: 2021
simple.explanation: Dalam format sitasi tanda kurung (parenthetical citation) APA 7th edition, format standarnya adalah (Nama Belakang, Tahun): '(Smith, 2021)'.
hints: Format sitasi dalam kurung standar APA.
Gunakan 'Smith, 2021'.

simple.prompt: Third-person academic stance: Instead of writing 'I believe that...', an academic author writes: '___ that...'
options: It is argued
I think
My feeling is
simple.explanation: Konvensi penulisan akademik mengutamakan sudut pandang objektif persona ketiga atau pasif impersonal: 'It is argued that...'.
hints: Sudut pandang objektif pasif impersonal.
Gunakan 'It is argued'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat sitasi naratif format APA.
simple.targetSentence: Johnson demonstrated that cognitive behavioral therapy reduces severe anxiety.
simple.explanation: Johnson demonstrated that + cognitive behavioral therapy reduces severe anxiety.
hints: Mulai dengan nama peneliti dan kata kerja: 'Johnson demonstrated that'.
Temuan: 'cognitive behavioral therapy reduces severe anxiety'.

simple.prompt: Abbreviation 'et al.': 'The seminal study by Harrison ___ revolutionized macroeconomic modeling.'
options: et al.
etc.
i.e.
simple.explanation: 'et al.' (singkatan dari bahasa Latin 'et alia' = dan kawan-kawan) digunakan saat merujuk pada tiga penulis atau lebih dalam karya ilmiah.
hints: Singkatan Latin untuk 'dan rekan-rekan peneliti'.
Gunakan 'et al.'.

simple.targetSentence: The primary hypothesis posited a positive relationship between variables.
simple.explanation: The primary hypothesis posited + a positive relationship between variables.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The primary hypothesis posited'.
Hubungan variabel: 'a positive relationship between variables'.

simple.prompt: Signaling methodology: 'Quantitative data was gathered ___ structured questionnaires.'
options: via
throughout of
with using
simple.explanation: Preposisi formal 'via' atau 'by means of' lazim digunakan untuk mendeskripsikan instrumen pengumpulan data.
hints: Preposisi formal jalur pengumpulan data.
Gunakan 'via'.

simple.targetSentence: A substantial body of literature supports this theoretical assumption.
simple.explanation: A substantial body of literature supports + this theoretical assumption.
hints: Mulai dengan 'A substantial body of literature supports'.
Objek teoretis: 'this theoretical assumption'.

simple.prompt: In APA 7th edition in-text citation, how do you cite a single author at the end of a paraphrased sentence?
options: (Rahman, 2023)
(Rahman 2023 page)
(Mr. Rahman, 2023)
simple.explanation: Format kutipan dalam-teks APA standar untuk parafrase memuat nama belakang penulis dan tahun yang dipisah koma di dalam tanda kurung: '(Rahman, 2023)'.
hints: Jangan menyertakan gelar ('Mr.') dan wajib pisahkan penulis & tahun dengan koma.
Format: (Last Name, Year).

simple.prompt: How does a NARRATIVE citation integrate the author's name directly into the grammatical flow of the sentence?
options: Rahman (2023) demonstrated that urban tree canopies lower street heat.
Urban tree canopies lower street heat Rahman (2023).
(Rahman) 2023 demonstrated that urban tree canopies lower street heat.
simple.explanation: Dalam narrative citation, nama penulis menjadi bagian subjek kalimat diikuti tahun dalam tanda kurung tepat di sebelahnya: 'Rahman (2023) demonstrated...'.
hints: Subjek kalimat langsung diisi nama belakang penulis, diikuti tahun di tanda kurung.
Pilih struktur 'Author (Year) verb...'.

simple.prompt: Which sentence maintains an appropriately OBJECTIVE academic stance (avoiding overly personal bias)?
options: Evidence suggests that early phonological training strengthens reading fluency.
I personally feel deeply in my heart that reading training is super important.
Everybody obviously agrees that nobody dislikes reading fluency.
simple.explanation: Penulisan akademik menghindari klaim emosional pribadi ('I personally feel deeply...') maupun generalisasi ekstrem ('Everybody obviously...'), dan berfokus pada apa yang ditunjukkan bukti.
hints: Fokuskan subjek kalimat pada bukti ('Evidence suggests...').
Hindari bahasa emosional pribadi.

simple.prompt: In academic writing, the Latin abbreviation '___' (= and others) is used when citing sources with three or more authors in APA 7.
options: et al.
e.g.
i.e.
simple.explanation: 'et al.' (dari 'et alii' = dan kawan-kawan) dipakai di belakang nama penulis pertama untuk sumber dengan ≥3 penulis dalam APA 7: '(Lin et al., 2022)'.
hints: Singkatan untuk menggantikan daftar penulis kedua, ketiga, dst.
Gunakan 'et al.' (perhatikan titik setelah 'al.').

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan bimbingan skripsi tentang perbedaan 'i.e.' dan 'e.g.'.
dialogue: Student
Should I write '(e.g., Jakarta and Surabaya)' when listing two EXAMPLES out of many Indonesian cities?
Supervisor
Yes! '___' introduces non-exhaustive examples, whereas 'i.e.' introduces a complete restatement or definition.
options: e.g.
et al.
viz.
simple.explanation: 'e.g.' (exempli gratia = misalnya) untuk memberi beberapa contoh; 'i.e.' (id est = yaitu) untuk memperjelas arti atau daftar lengkap.
hints: Konteksnya dua contoh dari banyak kota lainnya.
Singkatan untuk 'misalnya' adalah 'e.g.'.

simple.prompt: When stating a tentative prediction to be tested in an empirical study, which verb fits 'Formulating Hypotheses' best?
options: We hypothesize that higher soil salinity will inhibit early root elongation.
We blindly guess that salt totally kills roots maybe.
We swear salt definitely wrecks every single plant root.
simple.explanation: Hipotesis ilmiah dirumuskan dengan jelas, dapat diuji secara empiris, dan memakai verb tepat seperti 'hypothesize' atau 'predict'.
hints: Hipotesis harus terukur dan dapat diuji.
Pilih kalimat dengan verb ilmiah 'hypothesize'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan menggabungkan gelar dan inisial nama depan di dalam kutipan APA berikut.
simple.draft: According to (Dr. Agus Rahman, 2021), coastal wetlands absorb storm surges effectively.
options: According to Rahman (2021), coastal wetlands absorb storm surges effectively.
According to Dr. Rahman (2021), coastal wetlands absorb storm surges effectively.
According to (Rahman, 2021), coastal wetlands absorb storm surges effectively.
simple.explanation: Dalam sitasi APA: 1) Jangan masukkan gelar ('Dr.') atau nama depan ('Agus'); 2) Jika memakai 'According to...', nama penulis menjadi bagian teks sehingga hanya tahun yang masuk ke dalam tanda kurung ('According to Rahman (2021),...').
hints: Setelah 'According to', jangan taruh seluruh nama dan tahun di dalam satu kurung.
Hapus 'Dr.' dan nama depan.

simple.prompt: Which verb phrase belongs in a formal Methodology section describing how subjects were selected?
options: Participants were recruited via stratified random sampling across three clinics.
We grabbed random folks hanging around three clinics.
Three clinics handed us whoever happened to walk by.
simple.explanation: Bagian Methodology menuntut terminologi desain penelitian yang baku ('stratified random sampling', 'were recruited').
hints: Gunakan istilah metodologi riset yang standar dan dapat direplikasi.
Pilih kalimat beristilah metodologi presisi.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tinjauan pustaka memakai narrative citation dan reporting verb netral.
simple.targetSentence: Tanaka (2022) observed a clear decline in summer glacier thickness across northern valleys.
hints: Awali dengan 'Tanaka (2022) observed a clear decline'.
Tambahkan objek dan lokasi.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan hasil statistik dasar yang objektif.
simple.targetSentence: Survey results indicate a statistically significant correlation between sleep duration and recall accuracy.
simple.explanation: Menyatakan temuan statistik dengan 'indicate a statistically significant correlation between A and B'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Survey results indicate a statistically significant'.
Lengkapi dengan 'correlation between sleep duration and recall accuracy'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog etika sitasi ilmiah dalam penulisan tesis.
dialogue: Supervisor
Did you formulate this conceptual model yourself?
Student
No, it was ___ from the framework originally developed by Vygotsky.
options: adapted
copied
stolen
intermediate.explanation: 'Adapted from...' adalah konvensi akademik baku untuk menyebutkan modifikasi kerangka kerja dari pemikir terdahulu secara etis dan sah.
hints: Istilah etis modifikasi model teoretis terdahulu.
Gunakan 'adapted'.

intermediate.prompt: Latin abbreviations: 'The survey questioned key stakeholders, ___ municipal leaders and civil advocates.'
options: i.e.
e.g.
ibid.
intermediate.explanation: 'i.e.' (id est = yaitu / that is) digunakan saat menyatakan identitas pasti, sedangkan 'e.g.' (exempli gratia = contohnya) digunakan untuk memberikan contoh sampel ilustratif. Jika menyebutkan contoh: gunakan 'e.g.'.
hints: Singkatan untuk 'for example' (exempli gratia).
Pilih 'e.g.' (atau i.e. jika rincian definitif). Di sini adalah contoh ilustratif: e.g.

intermediate.prompt: Reporting verbs for neutral literature reviews: 'Davis (2019) ___ that social capital mitigates poverty.'
options: observes
shouts
insists stubbornly
intermediate.explanation: Reporting verb netral berbobot seperti 'observes', 'maintains', 'contends', atau 'posits' adalah pilar tinjauan pustaka akademik.
hints: Kata kerja pelaporan netral akademis.
Gunakan 'observes'.

intermediate.targetSentence: The scope of this investigation is confined to urban municipalities.
intermediate.explanation: The scope of this investigation + is confined to urban municipalities.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The scope of this investigation'.
Batasan: 'is confined to urban municipalities'.

intermediate.prompt: Latin abbreviation 'cf.': In scholarly footnotes, 'cf.' directs the reader to:
options: compare with an alternative or opposing source
congratulate the author
continue reading without stopping
intermediate.explanation: 'cf.' (singkatan dari bahasa Latin 'confer') menginstruksikan pembaca untuk 'membandingkan' dengan sumber atau pandangan lain.
hints: Singkatan Latin untuk membandingkan (confer).
Pilih 'compare with an alternative or opposing source'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pemaparan data statistik signifikan.
intermediate.targetSentence: The statistical analysis revealed a statistically significant correlation.
intermediate.explanation: The statistical analysis revealed + a statistically significant correlation.
hints: Subjek: 'The statistical analysis revealed'.
Temuan: 'a statistically significant correlation'.

dialogue: External Examiner
Was the sample size sufficient to generalize the findings?
PhD Candidate
Yes, a post-hoc power calculation confirmed statistical ___.
options: validity
goodness
correctness
intermediate.explanation: 'Statistical validity' adalah terminologi baku untuk keabsahan metodologis dan daya uji generalisasi temuan riset.
hints: Terminologi baku keabsahan statistik.
Gunakan 'validity'.

intermediate.prompt: In APA 7, when citing a DIRECT word-for-word quotation (not a paraphrase), what extra element MUST appear inside the parenthetical citation?
options: the exact page number (e.g., 'p. 42') or paragraph number
the publisher's street address and ISBN code
the author's academic degree and email
intermediate.explanation: Kutipan langsung kata-demi-kata dalam APA wajib menyertakan nomor halaman spesifik ('p. 42' atau 'pp. 42–43'), sedangkan parafrase tidak diwajibkan.
hints: Pembaca harus bisa menemukan lokasi tepat kalimat kutipan langsung tersebut.
Sertakan nomor halaman ('p. 42').

intermediate.prompt: Choose the reporting verb that accurately signals the cited scholar EXPLICITLY REJECTED an older assumption:
options: refuted / challenged
corroborated / echoed
noted / observed
intermediate.explanation: Dalam literature review, pemilihan reporting verb menunjukkan posisi akademis penulis: 'refuted' atau 'challenged' menandai sanggahan kuat; 'corroborated' menandai dukungan.
hints: Cari kata kerja pelaporan yang menyatakan penolakan/sanggahan argumen.
Pilih 'refuted / challenged'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan pembimbing skripsi tentang membatasi ruang lingkup kajian (delimiting scope).
dialogue: Candidate
What if examiners ask why I excluded maritime shipping outside Southeast Asia?
Supervisor
State your methodological boundary clearly early on: 'This study is deliberately ___ Southeast Asian ferry corridors.'
options: delimited to / confined to
ignorant of
bored by
intermediate.explanation: Menjelaskan batasan cakupan riset ('delimiting study scope') dilakukan dengan tegas memakai frasa akademik seperti 'is confined to' atau 'focuses exclusively on' disertai alasan metodologis.
hints: Pembatasan fokus penelitian bersifat disengaja demi kedalaman analisis.
Gunakan 'delimited to / confined to'.

intermediate.prompt: Identify the sentence demonstrating genuine academic SYNTHESIS rather than a flat list of disconnected summaries:
options: Whereas Patel (2020) emphasized tax incentives, both Wu (2021) and Adi (2023) concluded that grid reliability remains the primary driver of industrial adoption.
Patel (2020) studied tax. Wu (2021) studied grid. Adi (2023) also wrote a paper on energy.
Patel, Wu, and Adi all exist in the library database and wrote about things.
intermediate.explanation: Sintesis literatur mempertemukan para peneliti dalam satu kalimat analitis—membandingkan kesepakatan ('both ... concluded') dan perbedaan fokus ('Whereas...') antar-studi.
hints: Sintesis membandingkan dan mengelompokkan temuan beberapa sumber sekaligus.
Hindari daftar ringkasan terpisah satu per satu ('A studied X. B studied Y.').

intermediate.prompt: Note the Latin convention: '___' (often italicized or noted in references for exact errors inside an original direct quote) signals 'thus it was written in the original source'.
options: [sic]
cf.
ibid.
intermediate.explanation: '[sic]' disisipkan setelah kata yang salah ketik atau tidak baku di dalam kutipan langsung untuk menunjukkan bahwa kesalahan tersebut berasal dari sumber aslinya, bukan salah ketik pengutip.
hints: Menandai keaslian kesalahan ejaan pada naskah kutipan langsung.
Gunakan tanda kurung siku '[sic]'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan parafrase malas (patchwriting) yang terlalu mirip struktur dan kata-kata sumber aslinya berikut.
intermediate.draft: Original: 'Urban wetlands absorb storm runoff quickly and filter heavy metals from highway drainage.' Patchwriting: 'City wetlands absorb storm water quickly and filter heavy metals out of highway drainage.'
options: By retaining storm water and trapping roadside pollutants, urban wetlands mitigate flood peaks and improve runoff quality.
Urban wetlands take in storm runoff fastly and screen heavy metals from road drainage.
Urban wetlands absorb storm runoff quickly and filter heavy metals from highway drainage (Author, 2024).
intermediate.explanation: Sekadar menukar beberapa sinonim sambil mempertahankan kerangka kalimat persis sumber ('patchwriting') masih tergolong plagiarisme struktural! Parafrase sejati menyusun ulang struktur sintaksis sekaligus mempertahankan makna inti dengan akurasi ilmiah.
hints: Jangan hanya mengganti 2–3 kata dengan sinonim sementara struktur tetap identik.
Ubah struktur klausa dan kosakata secara menyeluruh sambil menjaga makna.

intermediate.prompt: Choose the most accurate formula for reporting statistical non-significance objectively:
options: No statistically significant difference was observed between the control and intervention cohorts (p = .34).
The experiment totally failed because both groups ended up looking pretty identical.
Clearly the intervention did literally zero things to anyone at all.
intermediate.explanation: Hasil dengan p-value > 0.05 dilaporkan secara netral dengan frasa baku 'No statistically significant difference was observed...' beserta nilai p-nya — hindari menyebut penelitian 'gagal total' atau 'sama persis'.
hints: Nilai p = 0.34 menandakan hasil tidak signifikan secara statistik.
Gunakan formulasi netral tanpa bahasa emosional.

intermediate.prompt: In literature reviews, when identifying a RESEARCH GAP (celah penelitian yang belum terjawab), which transition signals your study's contribution best?
options: Despite extensive urban trials, little longitudinal research has examined rural clinic adoption.
Previous scientists missed everything because nobody knew how to run surveys.
There are zero papers on anything related to rural clinics anywhere in history.
intermediate.explanation: 'Despite extensive [X], little [research] has examined [Y]' menghargai kontribusi riset terdahulu sambil menunjukkan celah spesifik yang menjadi alasan studi baru.
hints: Ungkapkan celah penelitian secara terukur ('little ... has examined'), bukan mengklaim 'zero papers in history'.
Pilih transisi pengakuan + celah fokus.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang mendefinisikan batas cakupan studi (delimiting scope) secara jelas.
intermediate.targetSentence: To maintain analytical depth, this thesis restricts its scope to post-2015 municipal bond issues.
intermediate.explanation: Menjelaskan alasan ('To maintain analytical depth') diikuti 'restricts its scope to...' menunjukkan ketelitian desain studi.
hints: Awali dengan 'To maintain analytical depth,'.
Tambahkan klausa batasan 'this thesis restricts its scope to...'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat sintesis tinjauan pustaka dengan verb pelapor yang tepat.
intermediate.targetSentence: Although earlier surveys linked flexible hours to higher output, recent audits question that causal link.
intermediate.explanation: 'Although earlier surveys linked ... recent audits question' menyintesiskan pergeseran konsensus riset dari waktu ke waktu.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Although earlier surveys linked flexible hours to higher output,'.
Lengkapi klausa kontrasnya 'recent audits question that causal link'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi plagiarisme mosaik (patchwriting) agar menjadi sintesis parafrasa akademik yang sah.
complex.draft: According to researcher Brown, humans need oxygen to breathe and live comfortably in their everyday life.
options: Brown (2018) posits that oxygen homeostasis constitutes a fundamental physiological requirement for sustained human metabolic function.
Humans need oxygen to live as Brown said in his paper.
Brown said that we all need oxygen to breathe every day.
complex.explanation: Parafrasa akademik yang unggul menerjemahkan ide dasar ke dalam register terminologi ilmiah presisi ('oxygen homeostasis constitutes a fundamental physiological requirement...') dengan sitasi yang tepat.
hints: Gunakan register ilmiah presisi dan format sitasi naratif.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Epistemological role of the 'Literature Review' in a doctoral dissertation:
options: To map the contested intellectual terrain, locate a distinct knowledge deficit (gap in literature), and justify the necessity of the current inquiry.
To flatter famous senior professors so they pass the defense.
To fill up empty pages to meet university word counts.
complex.explanation: Tinjauan pustaka doktoral bertujuan memetakan perdebatan keilmuan, mengidentifikasi celah kebaruan (gap in knowledge), dan melegitimasi urgensi penelitian yang dilakukan.
hints: Memetakan diskursus ilmiah dan menemukan celah pengetahuan (gap).
Pilih opsi map the contested intellectual terrain and locate a knowledge deficit.

complex.prompt: Which reporting verb conveys critical skepticism toward another author's unverified claim?
options: alleges
proves
demonstrates
complex.explanation: 'Alleges' (atau claims without substantiation) menandakan bahwa penulis artikel bersikap skeptis dan belum meyakini kebenaran klaim sumber yang dikutip.
hints: Menandakan keraguan/skeptisisme kritis terhadap klaim sumber.
Gunakan 'alleges'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat sintesis pustaka komparatif tingkat tinggi.
complex.targetSentence: While orthodox neoclassical economists prioritize deregulation institutional theorists emphasize robust regulatory governance.
complex.explanation: While orthodox neoclassical economists prioritize deregulation + institutional theorists emphasize robust regulatory governance.
hints: Klausa pembanding: 'While orthodox neoclassical economists prioritize deregulation'.
Klausa kontras mazhab: 'institutional theorists emphasize robust regulatory governance'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan format sitasi sekunder (secondary citations).
complex.draft: Foucault cited in Miller 1991 said that power is pervasive.
options: As Foucault (1975, as cited in Miller, 1991) contends, power relations are pervasive across social institutions.
Foucault who was read in Miller 1991 argued power is everywhere.
Miller 1991 reading Foucault said power is pervasive.
complex.explanation: Format sitasi sekunder standar APA 7th: 'Foucault (1975, as cited in Miller, 1991) contends...' dengan kata kerja pelaporan akademik berbobot.
hints: Format baku sitasi sekunder: as cited in.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence formulating a research limitation with consummate scholarly dignity:
options: The cross-sectional design inherently precludes establishing definitive causal inferences between the observed variables.
Our study has a bad design so we cannot be sure of anything.
We could not find out what causes what because time ran out.
complex.explanation: 'The cross-sectional design inherently precludes establishing definitive causal inferences...' adalah formulasi batasan metodologi yang sangat berkelas dan jujur secara epistemik.
hints: Formulasi batasan metodologis ilmiah berbobot tinggi.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog sidang komite etik riset institusi.
dialogue: Committee Chair
How will the project protect vulnerable human subjects from coercion?
Principal Investigator
All protocols strictly adhere to the ethical tenets codified in the ___.
options: Declaration of Helsinki
Common Sense Guide
Popular Internet Forum
complex.explanation: Deklarasi Helsinki (Declaration of Helsinki) adalah konvensi internasional kanonikal mengenai etika riset medis dan biomedis pada subjek manusia.
hints: Konvensi etika riset internasional kanonikal.
Gunakan 'Declaration of Helsinki'.

complex.prompt: Check tense conventions inside an academic paper: why does 'Smith (2019) argued...' take Past Simple while 'Table 3 summarizes...' takes Present Simple?
options: Specific past research events/author actions use Past Simple, whereas still-present tables/figures and established generalizations use Present Simple
Authors who are living require Present Simple, while retired researchers require Past Simple only in footnotes
APA 7 prohibits any tense shifts inside the same section
complex.explanation: Dalam konvensi IMRaD akademik: tindakan historis peneliti pada saat studi dilakukan ('Smith argued / found / measured') lazim memakai Past Simple (atau Present Perfect untuk tradisi berlanjut), sedangkan elemen teks yang hadir di depan pembaca sekarang ('Table 3 summarizes / Figure 2 illustrates') selalu memakai Present Simple.
hints: Bedakan tindakan penulis di tahun terbit (2019) vs keberadaan tabel di naskah saat ini.
Elemen visual dalam naskah saat ini memakai Present Simple.

complex.prompt: Notice ethical attribution rules: what is 'secondary citation' (and how does APA 7 treat '(Lin, 2010, as cited in Patel, 2022)')?
options: Citing an idea you only read inside another author's paper; acceptable sparingly only when the original source is truly unavailable
Copying another author's bibliography without reading either the primary or secondary text
Using '(et al.)' for single-authored monographs published before 2000
complex.explanation: Secondary citation dipakai ketika Anda tidak berhasil mengakses naskah asli Lin (2010) dan hanya membacanya melalui kutipan Patel (2022). Secara etika ilmiah, temukan dan baca sumber primer bila memungkinkan; gunakan 'as cited in' hanya jika sumber asli benar-benar tak terjangkau.
hints: Anda hanya membaca kutipan sumber A lewat tulisan penulis B.
Gunakan sebijak mungkin apabila naskah asli tak dapat diakses.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan mengganti huruf '&' dan 'and' secara keliru antara narrative vs parenthetical APA 7 citations berikut.
complex.draft: As Garcia & Tan (2021) argued, solar microgrids stabilize island voltage (Garcia and Tan, 2021).
options: As Garcia and Tan (2021) argued, solar microgrids stabilize island voltage (Garcia & Tan, 2021).
As Garcia & Tan (2021) argued, solar microgrids stabilize island voltage (Garcia & Tan, 2021).
As Garcia and Tan (2021) argued, solar microgrids stabilize island voltage (Garcia, and Tan, 2021).
complex.explanation: ATURAN KETAT APA 7: Dalam kalimat teks naratif, wajib menulis kata penuh 'and' ('Garcia and Tan (2021)'); sedangkan di dalam TANDA KURUNG parenthetical citation, wajib memakai ampersand '&' ('(Garcia & Tan, 2021)')!
hints: Di luar tanda kurung (teks berjalan) gunakan kata 'and'.
Di dalam tanda kurung sitasi APA gunakan simbol '&'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang Epistemological Literature Review (memetakan perdebatan, bukan meringkas berurutan).
dialogue: Examiner
Your literature review reads like an annotated bibliography — Study A said X, Study B said Y. How do you elevate it epistemologically?
Candidate
Organize sections around ___ rather than chronological author summaries.
options: competing theoretical claims, methodological debates, and unresolved tensions
alphabetical author last names and publication page counts
verbatim block quotes copied from every abstract
complex.explanation: Literature review tingkat doktoral/jurnal tidak menyusun ringkasan per penulis secara mekanis, melainkan memetakan tema perdebatan teoretis, celah metodologi, dan ketegangan temuan lintas penelitian.
hints: Fokusnya adalah peta tema konseptual dan perdebatan ilmiah.
Hindari urutan alfabetis atau daftar ringkasan terpisah.

complex.prompt: Distinguish 'cf.' from 'e.g.' inside academic footnotes: 'cf.' (confer) instructs the reader to ___.
options: compare this claim with another contrasting or supporting source
read a verbatim definition copied word for word
skip the remainder of the chapter entirely
complex.explanation: Singkatan Latin 'cf.' (confer = bandingkanlah dengan...) mengundang pembaca membandingkan argumen yang sedang dibahas dengan sumber pembanding lain.
hints: 'Cf.' berasal dari kata Latin 'confer' (= bandingkan).
Fungsinya mengarahkan pembaca membandingkan dua sumber.

complex.prompt: Why is 'prove' avoided in empirical social/natural science reporting ('Our survey proves beyond doubt...')?
options: Empirical sample studies support or corroborate hypotheses probabilistically rather than achieving mathematical proof
'Prove' is strictly an informal spoken slang verb
'Prove' cannot take a 'that'-clause in English grammar
complex.explanation: Dalam filsafat sains empiris (Popperian falsifiability), data sampel dapat mendukung ('support'), menguatkan ('corroborate'), atau konsisten dengan ('align with') hipotesis, tetapi jarang mengklaim 'prove' mutlak seperti pembuktian teorema matematika murni.
hints: Sains empiris bekerja dengan probabilitas dan bukti yang dapat direvisi.
Gunakan 'support / indicate / corroborate' alih-alih 'prove'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyatukan klaim sebab-akibat kausal dari studi korelasional semata berikut.
complex.draft: Because our cross-sectional survey showed a correlation between commute time and fatigue, driving directly causes chronic insomnia.
options: Although our cross-sectional survey identified a positive association between commute time and fatigue, longitudinal data is needed to establish causality.
Our cross-sectional survey proved beyond doubt that driving causes insomnia because commute time correlated with fatigue.
Commute time directly makes insomnia happen in our cross-sectional correlation study.
